products.name: Harbor House - Orange 43 - 1G Pre-roll
products.description: Harbor House brings you Orange 43 in a convenient 1g pre-roll, ready to light up and enjoy. This expertly crafted preroll showcases the beloved Orange 43 strain, celebrated for its vibrant citrus aroma and well-balanced effects. Expect zesty orange and sweet tropical notes with each smooth draw, creating an inviting sensory experience. Whether you're seeking creative inspiration, social energy, or simply a moment of euphoric relaxation, this pre-roll delivers consistent quality in a grab-and-go format. Harbor House ensures premium flower is carefully ground and rolled for an even burn every time. Perfect for seasoned enthusiasts and newcomers alike, Orange 43 offers a flavorful journey that's as refreshing as it is satisfying. Enjoy the convenience of a perfectly portioned 1g pre-roll that fits seamlessly into any lifestyle.

products.name: Harbor House - GMO - 1G Pre-roll
products.description: Harbor House brings you GMO in a convenient 1g pre-roll, ready to deliver a powerful and memorable experience. This premium preroll showcases the distinctive garlic, earthy, and pungent aroma that GMO is celebrated for, offering a robust flavor profile that stands out from the crowd. Known for its relaxing and euphoric effects, this strain is perfect for unwinding after a long day or melting away stress. Each pre-roll is expertly crafted for smooth, consistent burning and maximum enjoyment. Whether you're a seasoned enthusiast or exploring new favorites, Harbor House's GMO pre-roll provides quality and potency in every puff. Elevate your cannabis ritual with this bold, flavorful choice that delivers satisfaction from start to finish.

products.name: Harbor House - Lemon Cherry Sherbert - 1G Badder
products.description: Harbor House delivers premium concentrate craftsmanship with their Lemon Cherry Sherbert 1G Badder. This velvety extract showcases a delightful fusion of zesty lemon, sweet cherry, and creamy sherbet notes that dance across the palate. The badder consistency offers easy handling and versatile dabbing for concentrate enthusiasts seeking potent, flavorful sessions. Lemon Cherry Sherbert is known for delivering balanced effects that inspire creativity and euphoria while maintaining relaxation—perfect for unwinding after a long day or enhancing social gatherings. Each dab reveals complex terpene profiles with bright citrus top notes complemented by fruity cherry undertones and a smooth, creamy finish. Harbor House's meticulous extraction process preserves the strain's natural essence, resulting in a concentrate that's as flavorful as it is effective. Ideal for experienced users who appreciate quality extracts with exceptional taste and reliable potency.

image.alt: Harbor House - Lemon Cherry Sherbert - 1G Badder

products.name: Harbor House - Bajah Blast - .5G Cartridge - Distillate
products.description: Harbor House presents Bajah Blast, a premium 0.5g cartridge designed for convenient, flavorful vaping. This sleek cartridge delivers smooth, consistent draws with every use, making it perfect for both experienced enthusiasts and newcomers alike. Bajah Blast offers an energetic and uplifting experience that's ideal for social gatherings, creative projects, or daytime enjoyment. The flavor profile bursts with tropical and citrus notes, complemented by sweet undertones that make each puff refreshing and satisfying. Compatible with standard 510 thread batteries, this cartridge provides hassle-free portability and discreet consumption wherever your day takes you. Harbor House is committed to quality and consistency, ensuring every cartridge meets rigorous standards for purity and potency. Whether you're looking to elevate your mood, spark creativity, or simply unwind without feeling sedated, Bajah Blast delivers a well-rounded experience in a compact, user-friendly format. Perfect for on-the-go relief and enjoyment.

image.alt: Harbor House - Bajah Blast - .5G Cartridge - Distillate

products.name: Harbor House - Super Silver Haze x Albarino - 1G Badder
products.description: Harbor House presents Super Silver Haze x Albarino Badder, a premium 1g cannabis extract that combines two legendary genetics into one exceptional concentrate. This collaboration merges the uplifting, energetic qualities of Super Silver Haze with the unique aromatic profile of Albarino, creating a badder with a creamy, whipped texture that's perfect for dabbing. Expect a complex flavor profile featuring citrus, earthy, and herbal notes that dance across the palate with each session. The concentrate delivers focused, creative effects ideal for daytime use or social activities. Harbor House's expert extraction process preserves the full spectrum of cannabinoids and terpenes, ensuring maximum potency and flavor in every dab. This 1g badder offers cannabis connoisseurs a premium experience that showcases the craftsmanship and quality Harbor House is known for.
